#文生图 masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, solo, full body, Firefly (Honkai: Star Rail) inspired girl, standing gracefully,
pale silver-white long hair with black gradient tips, soft wavy hair, neat bangs,
light pink to magenta eyes, gentle gaze, faint smile, fair skin, subtle blush,
blue-green butterfly hairpin on the right side, matching teal ribbon earrings,
wearing a white off-shoulder dress with teal ribbon bow on the chest, black choker with teal cross ornament, elegant posture,
surrounded by softly glowing fireflies and floating light particles, faint mist, luminous soft aura,
white to pastel gradient background (white, light teal, pale blue), subtle light rays, ethereal atmosphere,
anime style, cinematic lighting, detailed clothing texture, soft focus, clean and dreamlike composition, perfect anatomy, glossy eyes, vivid highlights
